description: Operator-applied GitHub merge-queue parameters for main. Not enforced by CI; apply with tools/apply_merge_queue_policy.mjs. Goal: batch independent green PRs into one merge-group validation when they arrive close together, while keeping ALLGREEN so composition failures still block.
required_status_checks: Accessibility + language gate (axe on every PR)

elder_slot.external_seater_note: The one-auto-merge-at-a-time seat cap lives outside this repository. That seater should call pickElderSeatHolder() (or re-implement the same thresholds) before seating a younger ready PR so an aged PR is not overtaken.

notes: min_entries_to_merge_wait_minutes=5 forms a short merge train so near-simultaneous PRs share one merge_group when independent.
ALLGREEN is intentional: do not switch to looser grouping to hide composition failures.

Required checks are only Unit, Accessibility, and Reading-level — not Performance budgets (20-sample p95). That job path-filters on `perf` (site chrome/assets + budget harness) and reports SUCCESS without measuring for data/worker/docs diffs.
Runtime multi-locale stray-English is not a required check; Unit static lint owns that class.

A same-repo merge-when-ready seat cap (one auto-merge at a time) is complementary and lives outside this repo. Elder slot reservation policy for that seater is tools/elder_merge_slot.mjs + elder_slot above.
